Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
The issue was identified in the date handling logic of the report. While generating the report for a specific “As On” date, the date parameter was incorrectly considering the current date instead of the selected “As On” date. Due to this, the balances in the Horizontal P&L Report were not matching correctly.
Corrective Action
The date-handling logic has been corrected to ensure that the report considers the exact “As On” date selected by the user while calculating the balances.
We have also verified the Vertical P&L Report, and the balances are matching correctly.
We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience caused.
